summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1.6B+ in SPX 7000C accumulation for 2026/2027 expirations and aggressive call buying in META (P/C 0.24) and AMD (P/C 0.32). A highly persistent multi-day accumulation pattern is visible in SPX 7000C strikes (exp 2026-12-18 and 2026-10-16), with single strikes seeing over $4B in flow over the last four sessions. While the heavy SPX call buying dominates, the significant SPY and QQQ put premiums (P/C > 1.45) suggest some short-term hedging or localized volatility plays. Traders should monitor SPX price action near the 8000P level and watch for follow-through in META and NVDA to confirm if this massive long-dated call buying translates into immediate momentum.
